description_en: You can call DeleteArtifact to delete an artifact or a specific version of an artifact
description_zh: 当您不再需要部署物或部署物对应版本，调用DeleteArtifact删除部署物
name: DeleteArtifact

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the artifact.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/469993.html to obtain the artifact ID
parameters.help_zh:
部署物ID。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/469993.html获取部署物ID
parameters.name: artifact_id

parameters.help_en:
The version of the artifact.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/469995.html to obtain the artifact version
parameters.help_zh:
部署物版本。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/469995.html获取部署物版本
parameters.name: artifact_version

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique for each request. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters long
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token
